notes.query_counting: query_count is -1 for all scenarios — raw SQL queries are explicit in code and statically known. SQLAlchemy event listener is attached to the engine but raw_sql returns -1 explicitly.
notes.engine: Shared SQLAlchemy engine with QueuePool (pool_size=10). Raw SQL uses engine.connect() per scenario call.
notes.C1: 10,000 inserts in chunks of 500 via SQLAlchemy Core text(). Each chunk is a separate executemany call.
notes.C2: UPDATE FROM subquery, LIMIT 1000 rows. See methodology/c2_limit_analysis.json.
notes.D1: Uses raw SQL BEGIN/COMMIT via text() to avoid nested transaction issues with SQLAlchemy connection context manager.
notes.B1: n_warmup: 1233 — warm-up did not converge within limit. Random order_id causes high CV.

A1.description: Simple SELECT by primary key via SQLAlchemy text()

A2.description: Filtered list with ORDER BY and LIMIT via text()

A3.description: N+1 diagnostic — 100 orders, 1 query per user (intentional)

A4.description: Eager loading via INNER JOIN — orders with users in single query

B2.description: Aggregate with GROUP BY — categories with product count and avg price
